about: Flosendo decisions on upstream chenhg5/cc-connect commits (EDEN-1313 fork). Scored 9 Oct 2026 by Fati at Ivan's request ("only if it makes sense, and added value by scoring and looking at the cons and pros and consequences"). Verdicts: adopt | watch | declined | feature-off | have-equivalent | not-used | low-value. flosendo/upstream_report.py lists upstream commits not yet here.

Does not apply without c3a6a25e, which conflicts too. Take all three (c3a6a25e, 93b3a5da, 6ed762d3) only if the footer is ever shown.

781ead2b.subject: fix(core): generation-counted session busy lock with stale-break self-heal and stop-path release (#1838)
781ead2b.why: Busy-lock self-heal (generation-counted TryLock; breaks a lock held past busy_timeout when the agent process is dead). CORRECTION 9 Oct 2026: the symptom HAS happened to us - EDEN-1137 records two full freezes (#eden-dev 11 Sep, #eden-two 22 Sep: a session stuck busy, Ivan's messages queued until a restart), and its warning sign ("orphan: rendering without session lock") fired 8 times on 9 Oct. Being scored under EDEN-1137 against a smaller fork-local fix: large (+728/-171), touches 6 files we patched and every Unlock site, and changes TryLock's signature (our nudge fix 6ed03c23/79cfad75 calls it). SCORED under EDEN-1137, 2 Nov 2026: the freezes were not a lock held by a dead process, which is what this heals, but a live turn waiting for a reply the bridge had routed to the wakeup path (a resume's synthetic result, or a message folded into a turn the CLI started itself); EDEN-1137 fixed the routing with the CLI's command lifecycle. Stays watch: take it if a session stays busy with its agent process gone. RE-SCORED under EDEN-1852, 10 Nov 2026: the 6 Nov deaths (all three sessions at 19:41Z) were not that symptom either. No lock was held: A's engine turn had ended at 19:22:05Z (A died in a turn the CLI had started itself), and A's timer at 22:19:46Z and B's resume at 22:54:32Z each started a fresh process at once, with no busy, queue or stale line. A busy-lock self-heal would not have acted; what was missing was a log line, which EDEN-1852 adds. Stays watch.

Taking it is costly: it conflicts in agent/claudecode/session.go, core/engine.go and core/message.go, needs reportedCtxWindow and EventHookRejected (from 93b3a5da and 9355354f, neither taken), and writes to cs.events directly, which skips our orphan routing (emitEvent). Symptom that would make us take it: an agent missing a message Ivan shared or a table he pasted (none seen: 0 agent replies saying nothing came through). A test cherry-pick applies cleanly, but it changes what agents receive (attachment text, including link previews, is appended), so it needs Ivan.

80bdf304.subject: fix(claudecode): drop empty task-notification result on --resume; flush partial unsolicited text on cancel
80bdf304.why: ADOPTED 2 Nov 2026 under EDEN-1137, the claudecode half only (isEmptyTaskNotificationResult and its drop in handleResult, verbatim). The watch symptom happened: on 2 Nov the first prompt into a resumed session got the synthetic task-notification result 3 times out of 3, and #eden-dev's session was killed by the idle timeout at 09:51:46Z with its background job. Ruled by the chief of staff under Ivan's 9 Oct rule (EDEN-1137 comment 95053b0a; 'needs Ivan' was the scorer's flag), flagged to Ivan after the fact.

EDEN-1618.what: A message queued behind a busy session is never lost without its sender being told. Idle kill: the queue goes to a fresh session once the dead turn releases it, and alert_session_key hears of it. Reset (/new, /stop, a self-reset): each queued message gets 'Not processed (<why>): <first line>' in its own thread. Restart: Engine.Stop writes the queues to <data dir>/run/pending_queue_<project>.json; when a platform is ready again each sender gets the same notice in the message's thread (Slack: ReplyTargetKey). Every drop logs remaining_queue=0, and the drain log carries remaining_queue, so deploy.sh queued is right.
EDEN-1618.why: 19 Oct 2026: Ivan's 'sign 1' and ten numbered answers sat in such a queue for two hours and were lost to the idle kill; 6 queued messages were dropped 6 to 20 Oct (EDEN-1614 audit). Ivan, 20 Oct: 'promote 1618'.
files: core/engine.go (notifyDroppedQueuedMessages, the idle kill, Engine.Stop, onPlatformReady, the drain log, the alertSessionKey field)
EDEN-1618.upstream_conflict_risk: core/engine.go, five small hunks; an upstream change to notifyDroppedQueuedMessages, the idle-timeout case or Engine.Stop needs these re-applied.

EDEN-1137.what: Each CLI turn is routed by the CLI's own command lifecycle. Send puts a uuid on each message; the CLI echoes it as command_uuid in command_lifecycle (queued, started, completed). Once it has echoed one, a turn's events go to the engine's turn exactly when one of our commands has started, else to the wakeup path; when ours starts inside a turn already going to the wakeup path, the turn moves to the engine (the part before is flushed as a wakeup, text only, at once). If a turn's result has come, ours is still only queued and the CLI writes nothing for 30 s, the engine's turn ends with EDEN-1618's 'Not processed' notice; the quiet is not counted from a turn's system init to its result, and a message the CLI ends without starting it (cancelled, discarded, completed with no started) ends the turn at once. The signal names the messages it gives up on and the engine acts on it only while the agent says it is current (the latest one, until the engine's turn settles). Also: 80bdf304's claudecode half (the resume's empty task-notification result is dropped); system lines and tool results follow the open turn (D1b); a compaction result (Done=false) keeps the turn (D2); only model output disarms the phantom grace (D3a); every engine turn end calls SettleTurn (D3d); processInteractiveEvents takes the agent session under its lock once, so a /new before its event loop ends the turn instead of a nil dereference that stopped the bridge (upstream defect). One log line per session names the mode: 'flosendo: turn routing by command lifecycle' or '... by counter'. A CLI that never echoes keeps the counter (declared limit: there, a message folded into a self-fired turn still waits for the idle kill).
EDEN-1137.why: EDEN-1137: a session stuck busy until the idle kill: 22 Oct (the chief of staff's channel, a message folded into a self-fired turn) and 2 Nov 09:51Z (#eden-dev, a resume's synthetic result; its background job died with it). Ivan: 'i want to be able to continue building even if i am not on the office' (7 Oct) and 'alright, continue all the build 24/7' (2 Nov). The probe of the real CLI 2.1.286 (D0) reproduced both shapes and a third (a message answered as a wakeup, the self-fired text as the reply).
files: agent/claudecode/session.go (Send's uuid, the command_lifecycle case, emitEvent's channel choice, the two bypasses, the 80bdf304 drop, the system init's pause, the quiet timer's stop before the channels close)
